title: The New York Times Just Banned the New Photoshop. The Reason Matters More Than the Ban
excerpt: The Times told its freelancers to avoid Photoshop 2027 because some tools now use generative AI without making it obvious. The risk is not the edit. It is the metadata that follows it.

title: Your Vintage Lens Is Not Broken. It Is Just Honest About Light
excerpt: Mount an old manual lens on a mirrorless body and point it at a bright window, and the shadows wash to gray. That haze has a name, a history, and a use, once you understand coatings.

title: A 12mm Lens for $489 Is Cheap. Learning to Use It Is the Expensive Part
excerpt: TTArtisan just announced a $489 autofocus 12mm f/2.8 for full-frame Sony and Nikon. The price is the easy part. A 122-degree field of view punishes lazy composition like no other focal length.
